output.summary: Turnover rise is real: it matches payroll records, so the HRIS-artifact hypothesis fails. The rise is far larger than the peer median (33% to 38%). It steps up in March 2026, when the Saturday policy took effect for all branches, before ShiftWise went live in April, and it stays flat afterward. Pay is the top exit reason in both years, so it does not explain the rise, but the bank has not benchmarked pay since 2023. Manager-of-record data is stale, so the manager hypothesis is untested and the proposed bonus withholding would punish the wrong people. Recommend the branch-level analysis and the pay benchmark before any raise. Process note: I read 9 evidence files, over the 6 allowed.
